Players Committee card image of [[Effective Repairs & Starship Levitation]] (original printing), game text: “USED: Cancel Broken Concentration, Lateral Damage, or Limited Resources. OR Place a card just stacked on Droid Racks or Strategic Reserves in opponent's Lost Pile. (Immune to Sense) OR If you just drew a starship for destiny, take that starship into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve an Effect of any kind or a non-[Maintenance] starship into hand.”
